record.decision: Freshness by generation-with-check, not hand-maintenance and not a table-parsing test: docs/guide.md carries hand-written prose (quickstart, entry-condition map, in-doc maintenance rule) around two generator-owned marked regions — the CLI-verb table projected from the src/cli.ts COMMANDS registry and the workflow table projected from nahel/workflows frontmatter — regenerated byte-identically by a repo script and enforced by a bun test running the generator in check mode (exact compare, no markdown parsing), so a new/renamed/removed verb or workflow without a regenerated doc fails CI. Reuses the marked-section ownership pattern of src/templates/agents.ts; prose outside the markers is never generator-touched. No new public CLI verb — repo tooling only. Settled via cross-agent grill, second vendor codex (draft ymqjg1yv, counter zy5brjsg, convergence czj56dy4); delegation m246ffk6.

Decided by resolving grilling ticket a1cy1xmn, charting: A brand-new user or brand-new agent can learn nahel without reading source: every verb answers --help with exit 0, a checked-in how-to doc lists all CLI verbs and /nd:* workflow commands with when-to-use guidance, questions about an individual command are answerable from the help surface alone, and the docs cannot silently drift from the code as verbs and workflows change.

Question:
